Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin. We appreciate your consideration of our programme.

Regarding the application deadline, The regular application period for Summer Semester 27 has closed. The next regular application period is for Winter Semester 27/28, from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 [Doc 1].

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Thank you again for your interest in our programme. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Kind regards,

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme catalogue.

Regarding English language requirements, according to our programme catalogue, the official language of instruction is English [Doc 1]. For admission to the Project Management and Data Science Master's programme, we require proof of CEFR level C1 or higher in English language skills. This can be demonstrated through TOEFL (95+ points for the internet-based test), IELTS (7.0+ points), PTE Academic Test (76+ points) or comparable tests giving CEFR level C1 [Doc 1]. Additionally, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree, will also be recognised as Level C1.

Please note that if the official language in your country of origin is English, no additional proof may be required. However, we recommend verifying this requirement with our admissions team to confirm.

We would like to inform you that our programme is classified as a presence study, meaning it requires on-campus attendance [Doc 1]. The programme starts in both Summer and Winter semesters.

Regarding the application process, please note that study places are allocated according to specific selection criteria.

As an international student, you are allowed to work part-time. According to our programme catalogue, many of our students hold a part-time job while studying with us [Doc 1]. As an international student, you are permitted to work 140 full days or 280 half days per year, or an unlimited number of days as an academic assistant.

If you have any further questions regarding the application process or programme requirements, please do not hesitate to contact our admissions team.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you took to reach out to us with your questions.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, we would like to clarify that our programme catalogue states that applicants can apply while still completing their Bachelor's degree [Doc 1]. However, please note that you will need to provide proof of your final transcript or certificate by the deadline mentioned in our Master's study programmes page [Doc 2].

Regarding English language requirements, according to our programme catalogue, we require a TOEFL test with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, an IELTS test (academic) with a level of at least 7.0, or a PTE academic test with at least 76 points [Doc 1]. We also accept comparable tests that attest to English language skills at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). If you have completed your Bachelor's degree in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you may be exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency.

Regarding application fees, we use uni-assist for our Master's programmes. The application fee is 75 euros, and the processing costs are also handled by uni-assist [Doc 3]. You can find more information on the application process via uni-assist on their website.

We would like to inform you that our programme has a limited capacity of 40 students per year, and we try to maintain small class sizes to ensure excellence in teaching [Doc 4].

Please note that you should apply via the HTW application portal if one of the following requirements applies to you: You obtained your first academic degree in Germany, you are a national of an EU or EEA country, or you have completed your Bachelor's degree at HTW Berlin. Otherwise, please apply via uni-assist [Doc 1].

We would like to remind you that our application deadline for the summer semester is 15 June, and we recommend applying early as it does not influence your chances of admission in any way [Doc 4].

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Programme catalogue match: International Business. https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master. catalogue degree Master. catalogue language English. catalogue study classification Presence study. catalogue start semesters Summer semester. Target degree: Master. Applicant country/background: India. Focus on application processing fees, uni-assist handling fees, payment by the application deadline, and whether the application route uses uni-assist. Do not focus on tuition fees.

response.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you took to reach out to us with your questions.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, we would like to clarify that our programme catalogue states that applicants can apply while still completing their Bachelor's degree [Doc 1]. However, please note that you will need to provide proof of your final transcript or certificate by the deadline mentioned in our Master's study programmes page [Doc 2].

Regarding English language requirements, according to our programme catalogue, we require a TOEFL test with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, an IELTS test (academic) with a level of at least 7.0, or a PTE academic test with at least 76 points [Doc 1]. We also accept comparable tests that attest to English language skills at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). If you have completed your Bachelor's degree in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you may be exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency.

Regarding application fees, we use uni-assist for our Master's programmes. The application fee is 75 euros, and the processing costs are also handled by uni-assist [Doc 3]. You can find more information on the application process via uni-assist on their website.

We would like to inform you that our programme has a limited capacity of 40 students per year, and we try to maintain small class sizes to ensure excellence in teaching [Doc 4].

Please note that you should apply via the HTW application portal if one of the following requirements applies to you: You obtained your first academic degree in Germany, you are a national of an EU or EEA country, or you have completed your Bachelor's degree at HTW Berlin. Otherwise, please apply via uni-assist [Doc 1].

We would like to remind you that our application deadline for the summer semester is 15 June, and we recommend applying early as it does not influence your chances of admission in any way [Doc 4].

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Reference links for staff verification:
